args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation incorrectly used ROUND_HALF_UP while FIN-212
requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` incorrectly used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while FIN-212 (and the function's own docstring) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- Updated `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, fixing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI passed on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (run ci-0001, commit 08d3cd5986), including `tests/test_money.py`.
